old_description: Miller Motor Company has been serving Centre Hall, PA with top-quality automotive parts and repair services since 1923. As a locally-owned business, we pride ourselves on our friendly, expert team and our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our ASE-certified technicians specialize in domestic, Asian, and European vehicles, offering everything from basic maintenance to complex repairs using state-of-the-art technology and trusted brands. about:
Miller Motor Company has operated from Centre Hall, Pennsylvania since 1923. The locally owned business began as an automotive parts and repair shop serving the surrounding community and continues today as a Carquest Auto Parts franchise.

The shop provides full-service automotive repair and maintenance for domestic, Asian, and European vehicles. Its ASE-certified technicians perform work ranging from oil changes and brake service to engine repair, transmission service, and ADAS calibration. The facility also stocks Carquest-branded parts and supplies, selling to both professional mechanics and DIY customers. Brands used in repairs include BG Products and Jasper Engine & Transmission.

Customers include Centre Hall-area drivers of makes such as Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota, Honda, BMW, and Audi, as well as independent repair shops and hobbyists purchasing parts over the counter. The shop offers complimentary multi-point inspections with any service, online appointment scheduling, and a warranty on parts and labor.

The company emphasizes honest communication, fair pricing, and community engagement as its guiding principles. It was founded to provide reliable automotive care to local families and maintains that focus through transparent estimates and a customer-centered approach.
